content: Google Lens OCR UX: user picks/captures image, Lens auto-detects and highlights text regions, tap-and-hold or drag selection handles to select spanned text, then action bar offers Copy / Listen / Translate / Search. No separate export function - copy-to-other-app is the primary output mechanism. Works from photo library, live camera viewfinder, and integrates into Chrome/Photos/Gboard ('Scan text').
